integrity_statement: Analytical derivation of distribution and strict optimizer uniqueness; independent source-code checks and finite experiments are supplementary. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to motion-invariant affine hyperplane cuts of right equilateral triangular prisms. Numerically quoted optimizer is a high-precision approximation to an exact unique root; not an independently interval-certified value. Priority remains provisional because a plausible 2026 full text and older stereology tables were not fully accessible.
title: Exact Crofton polygon-type law and unique pentagon optimum for right equilateral triangular prisms
